Episode 174. Bale's Misunderstanding (2)
Bale's eyes, originally gleaming faintly golden, were now blindingly bright as he gazed at Sandra. They took the shape of a cross.
'Sarah, the Lady?'
Jin narrowed his gaze, glancing alternately between Bale and Sandra. Valeria also shook her head, as if she had difficulty quickly understanding the situation.
Understandably, Sandra and Sarah didn't resemble each other.

To begin with, Sarah had the distinct black hair of pureblooded Runcandels, while Sandra had the white hair of a Zipple. In addition to physique, their eye color, attitude, aura were all different. Aside from their gender, there was nothing similar about them.
Still, Bale kept referring to Sandra as Sarah.
"I've missed you, Sarah!"
"Go away, you monster!"
"Disappear quickly, you're bothering Sarah."
"Disappear!"
Sandra said to Bale, and Bale said to Jin and Valeria. In this regrettable situation, the most frustrated was undoubtedly Hedo.
"Damn it!"
Although Hedo increased his descent speed by using his inner energy as propulsion, Sandra was also being accelerated by the gravitational force Bale created.
Sandra struggled to escape the pull and fall toward Jin, but she couldn't get out of Bale's grasp.

Just before Sandra could reach Bale, Jin and Valeria rushed forward, swinging their sword and staff. Even though Bale was mistaking Sandra for Sarah, they had to prevent an ally from falling into the hands of this madman.
No one knew how Bale would react the moment he realized Sandra was not Sarah.
Of course, it was an uncomfortable situation for Valeria. It was odd for her to be involved in saving a Zipple, not killing one.
"I'm sorry, Aria."
"It can't be helped, it's necessary. You have nothing to apologize for."
However, Bale changed Sandra's landing point in an instant by creating air pressure with his wings and gravitational pull with his hand.
Jin couldn't blindly unleash a powerful attack toward Bale, who was moving in a complicated and fast manner. If Sandra and Hedo got caught in it, it would backfire.
Having no choice, Jin and Valeria stepped back to prepare for the next situation. The fortunate part was that Sandra, being a half-immortal golem, wasn't suitable for a hostage situation.
"Sarah, Sarah Runcandel!"
Soon, Bale caught Sandra in a 'princely hug', a phrase often seen in romance novels, while flashing a wide smile. He also swung one of his wings fiercely.
Swinging his fist, he finally turned toward Hedo, who had been chasing him.
Whooosh-!
"Argh, ack!"
Hedo, struck by the wing, bounced off into a wall composed of aether and seawater. The impact caused a cascade of black seawater from the wall.
'Who would have thought we'd see that massive man so ignominiously repelled...'
But given Hedo's resilience, being merely deflected by the wing was a minor effect. A normal person who did not possess Hedo's robust body would have been instantly killed or completely crushed.
Jin and Valeria charged at Bale again. Bale was holding Sandra delicately, like carrying a newborn baby, thus he couldn't use his sword and had to fight using his wings alone.
Although his wings seemed soft, the strength of Bale's wings was unparalleled, even compared to the skin of a cemetery giant.
"Why do you keep calling her by another person's name, you lunatic!"
Hedo shouted as he emerged from the seawater wall. His shirt had been torn to shreds by his massive, swollen muscles, and his eyes were filled with more intense anger than ever before.
Hedo, who usually maintained a dignified demeanor, had already been ruined multiple times in this graveyard journey.
"I wanted to ask the same question, Sir Bale. The woman you're holding is not Lady Sarah. You should come to your senses."
At these words, Bale looked down at Sandra with wide eyes.
She, like a captured wild beast, was hitting Bale's face and chest with all her limbs. Naturally, the one getting hurt more was Sandra, and Bale didn't even try to block her attacks.
'Looking closer, her face seems slightly different… she's also taller.'
"Slightly?"
Jin was dumbfounded once more at Bale's indifferent voice.

'Her attitude has worsened, and she has become unspeakably weaker. Sarah, what have you been through? And stop, your fists are peeling. It's heartbreaking. Although it heals right away. Did you have regenerative abilities?'
"Let go, let go, you monster. How dare you try to kill my husband?"
'Husband? Who's your husband?'
"Our Mr. Jin!"
Bale glared at Jin.
'Didn't you say you were thinking about marrying Paddler after the war?'
"What nonsense are you spouting again! I don't care whether I'm Sarah or not."
'Paddler, that disgusting fellow, seems worse compared to him. It's a good thing, as it turns out. Paddler seems to be here too, we should end it here.'
"I'm not Sarah Runcandel, but Sandra Zipple. And yes, Mr. Jin is quite cool. Even you can see that."
'But he's your distant descendant, isn't that an inappropriate relationship?'
"Yes, yes. We were born from enemy families, in a tragic love affair... which makes it even more thrilling."
At some point, Sandra and Bale had begun a conversation. It seemed that the mad people had a common understanding.
"Anyway, it's okay, Sarah. Although your appearance has changed from what I remember, you've lost your right arm, and you've become weaker... Now I'll protect you. Just as you protected me.]
"Will you protect me?"
[Yes, Sarah Runcandel. My life, soul, and power exist only for you.]
Boom Boom Boom!
Suddenly, as if bombs were exploding, there was a loud noise from all directions. Surprisingly, it was the sound of the Graveyard Giants clapping their 'applause'.

So far, Jin, Hedo, Valeria, and even Sandra herself had clarified to Bale that she was not Sarah. In fact, Sandra did not even hide the fact that she was the child of Zipple, who was the enemy of Runcandel a thousand years ago.
'But Sir Bale continues to mistake Sandra as Lady Sarah...'
Could the reason be that Bale is not in a sound mental state because he woke up after a thousand years?
Somehow, Jin felt there might be another reason.
'Sir Bale gives a childlike impression in his speech and behavior compared to the power he possesses.'
Young kids, no. People often distort reality to protect themselves from too great a shock.
For example, cases where they can't accept the death of a lover or parent, and believe they are still alive.
Jin guessed that Bale's current state was no different. For instance, Bale now 'chooses to perceive' Sandra as Sarah.
"What a freaking crazy..."
Hedo spat out in anger.
"Towerkeeper, it seems Sir Bale will continue to perceive Sandra as Lady Sarah."
Hedo's anger was no longer directed at Jin.
"We must save the lady. It doesn't matter if we can't retrieve the sword now, from now on cooperate as much as possible in rescuing the lady, 12th generation."
"Of course I will, Towerkeeper. But... battling Bale right now might actually put Sandra in danger."
Jin pointed at the sky.
The sky, which had been discolored by aura and the energies of various factions, was gradually turning blue. It was the power of Cheongnoe, Paddler.
'He's gotten stronger. Either he has refined the power of chaos more, or he has regained his old state.'
It seemed that there had been a change in Paddler as well. A more pure and powerful energy was spreading compared to when they first fought in the Garden of the Sword.
'In addition, there's Lionel and Stahl, the added Black Line, and Chaos Dragons.'
Facing them along with Bale was too much of a burden. Especially since they hadn't fully understood Bale's power yet, but it was certain that he was more threatening than the strengthened Paddler.
Moreover, unlike when they stormed the Garden of the Sword alone, they now had companions to protect.
Despite his surging anger, Hedo began to objectively assess the situation.
"......You're right, 12th flagbearer. So what do you suggest?"
"I think the fact that Sir Bale recognizes Sandra as Lady Sarah could be a blessing in disguise."
"Ha, do you think that madman will fight for Miss Sandra?"
"What do you think, Tower Master?"
"What?"
"If it were you, wouldn't you fight for Sandra in any situation?"
"In this situation, I would try to escape with the lady. If that guy takes the lady and escapes....."
Hedo suddenly stopped speaking.

It was because he felt the power of Bale amplifying infinitely. The Cross Eye had become sharper, and the transformed black sword was emitting a gigantic light as if it were not a human, but a weapon of a god.
Hedo was not wrong.
In this situation, it should have been right to escape with Sandra. However, Bale had no reason to make such a choice.
He was confident that he was stronger than all of them combined.
"......Seriously, does he not even need to be nervous?"
"It seems so."
[Jin Runcandel. This time, I will finish you......]

Paddler, who had completely exited the dimension door, also stopped speaking like Hedo. He momentarily brightened his eyes with the thought of realizing revenge as soon as he saw Jin, but he scrunched his face upon seeing the Cemetery Giant and Bale.
[......Bale? Why are you here.]
[You've bravely come to find me, Paddler.]
Bale gave a slight smile.
Upon seeing him, Paddler noticeably faltered.
[And yet you are so weak, truly, whether then or now, you are fearless...... you.]
Jin felt that Paddler was stronger than before, but Bale, on the other hand, perceived that he had become weaker.

Bale, who had been glaring at Paddler as if to kill him, lowered his head and looked at Sandra. The face that had been like a demon until a moment ago was now gone, replaced by an infinitely kind expression.
[Sarah, would it be okay if I kill Paddler and his cronies today?]
Sandra responded nonchalantly.
"Oh, whether you smash them or kill them, do as you please. It'll be uncomfortable to fight while holding me like this, can you hand me over to Jin?"

[That's true. Even though I've become weaker, it would be difficult to tear them apart while holding you. Hmm...... That guy should be able to protect you sufficiently in the midst of a melee. I'll do that.]
"Yeah, yeah."
[Jin Runcandel, take good care of Sarah. If she has even a small bruise when the fight is over, you too will die by my hand.]
"Hey, it's forbidden to talk to Jin like that."
[I understand, Sarah. I'll correct it like this. Then you too will get very hurt, okay? Jin Runcandel.]
"That's also not okay. Geez, you keep saying nasty things to Jin."
[Tch, it might have been better when I was favoring Paddler. At that time, you too will be very tired, Jin Runcandel!]
As Bale handed Sandra to Jin and took flight, the group could only stare blankly at his retreating figure.
